demo.title: Choose a research path
demo.intro: This is a presentation of the offline tools. Switching paths changes the walkthrough; it does not run Python or place an order in your browser.
demo.setup: From the repository root, set an absolute DATA_ROOT and an external UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT first. The guide explains configuration. Demo generation refuses to overwrite existing data.
demo.sampleNote: Values below come from the deterministic demo generators. They are input examples, not market observations or performance results.

stock.title: From daily bars to portfolio diagnostics
stock.description: Compare simple allocation rules and experimental CNN signals using a shared daily backtest. Start with equal weights, then inspect the assumptions behind each model.
stock.sampleDetail: The bundled example uses fictional HK symbols. U.S. ETF strategy ideas are a separate research candidate, not a validated U.S. trading demo.
stock.limit: Daily fractional-weight approximation. No board-lot handling, auction simulation, minimum commissions or FX conversion. Check run_status: a signal failure is marked as strategy_fallback, not a successful zero-return strategy.

crypto.title: From an order book to simulated maker fills
crypto.description: Trace visible queues, public trades and order latency. Compare four quoting variants while keeping the simulator and measurement assumptions explicit.
crypto.sampleDetail: Bid 99.9, ask 100.1. The fixture contains 20 levels and 121 snapshots per date, across three fixed date labels.
crypto.limit: Visible-queue simulation, not an exchange matching engine. Funding is a signal rather than settlement. Signal horizons require an exactly representable sampling grid; audit quality reports invalid numeric values. Commands importing configuration still require data settings before help. Overlapping-order queue realism remains unverified.

research.title: Separate an idea from its evidence
research.intro: The research framework and the competition strategy are different stages. No competition strategy has been selected or registered.
research.stockBody: A candidate uses crypto sentiment to inform a U.S. ETF portfolio. Data permissions, point-in-time coverage and reproducible out-of-sample comparison remain open. The equity lab supplies offline baseline experiments; it is not that completed strategy.
research.cryptoBody: B0 starts from mid-price and inventory skew. B1 uses L1 microprice, B2 adapts spread to volatility, and B3 changes the inventory target using funding signals. Compare the models before drawing conclusions about their edge.

engineering.title: Research ends at an explicit boundary
engineering.body: The execution project separately validates versioned targets and lineage, applies Paper-first safeguards, and journals broker events. Demo reports are not executable target files.
engineering.warning: A complete supervised order lifecycle remains unverified. The published v1 target schema lists JP/US while runtime normalization also recognizes HK; this existing mismatch needs resolution before relying on an HK handoff.

rules.title: Competition context
rules.body: Built around the 2026 Hong Kong Quant Competition. Product eligibility and account permissions require separate confirmation.

footer.note: Synthetic demonstrations do not establish real-market profitability.

validation.title: What ran, with which data
validation.intro: Fixed-input diagnostics checked on 19 October 2026. These samples do not establish deployable performance. Different universes, windows and accounting models cannot be ranked together.
validation.limited: HK equity-lab runs use one stock; US runs use SPY only. They cannot validate stock selection or cross-sectional ranking. Fixed costs are 30 bps for HK and 20 bps for US, per traded notional.
validation.cnn: Image/CNN results can include in-sample predictions. No eligible walk-forward fold existed under the unchanged 1,260-day training window. A zero-position model is not a successful strategy.
validation.rootLimit: Monthly HK diagnostics use the same one-stock subset at 10 bps. Regional rotation uses five ETFs at 10 bps, native-currency prices and a common calendar. FX, dividends, self-financing drift and point-in-time universes are not fully represented.
validation.cryptoLimit: Archived 19–21 March 2026 events passed the recorded checks. Venue/product provenance and timezone are unverified. Maker fee is zero and latency is 100 ms. This is neither CoinPaprika L2 data nor verified live execution. Absolute PnL/drawdown have no funded-capital return denominator.
validation.gateway: The read-only Gateway handshake and one HK history request succeeded, then error 1100 interrupted collection. One reconnect was refused. No order method was called.
validation.details: Full methodology, input/config fingerprints and limitations
validation.providerNote: A successful discovery request does not establish historical entitlement, point-in-time availability or a trading interface. Raw provider data and account details are excluded.

expansion.title: Expanded data and retrospective experiments
expansion.intro: Real daily bars and new diagnostic reruns. These are retrospective research results, not accepted research or execution targets.
expansion.dailyNote: Both pools use 2023–2025 observations with 63 days of warmup. Equal weight buys once and holds; momentum selects positive trailing 63-day returns using only the previous close and otherwise holds cash. Costs are basis points per one-way traded notional. USDT is not USD. The disclosed fixed candidate pool has selection bias.
expansion.equityNote: 30 completed folds: 252 sessions of warmup and 63 evaluation sessions, with positions carried from each warmup. HK uses one stock; US uses SPY. These do not establish S&P500 stock-selection performance. Existing engine costs are 30 bps for HK and 20 bps for US; adjustment and availability timing remain unverified.
expansion.makerNote: Three archived days, 2026-03-19–21. Venue, product and account currency remain unknown. PnL is in recorded account units, not a funded percentage return. Baseline, 1 bps maker fee and 300 ms placement/cancellation latency change one factor at a time. A conservative-fill scenario is unsupported by the current model.

expansion.coverageNote: Coverage dates span the earliest and latest observed bars across products, not a common start date. Product histories differ. The evaluated study remains fixed to 2023–2025.

study.title: Fixed-plan real-data comparisons
study.intro: US stocks, Hong Kong stocks and crypto spot, evaluated with the same explicit cash-funded accounting. Expand a market to inspect each independent fold. These are retrospective research results, not accepted strategies or continuous account returns.
study.method: 252 observations of feature-only warmup; 63 stock sessions or 90 crypto days per fold. Previous-close signals with an idealized lagged-close allocation proxy. Every fold starts in cash, pays entry costs and keeps its final holdings. Stock equal weight rebalances daily; crypto equal weight buys and holds. Costs are one-way basis-point assumptions, not verified fills.
study.proxy: Exposure, turnover and flat-day figures are daily-model proxies. They do not establish competition eligibility. US/HK use 252 periods per year; crypto uses 365. USD, HKD and USDT remain separate.
study.limits: Fixed current pools have selection bias. Stock dividends, historical adjustment timing, lots, capacity and real slippage are unverified. Crypto spot research does not establish an authorized execution venue or product. Archived maker results below remain separate and were not rerun.

dashboard.intro: Explore historical strategy outcomes across US stocks, Hong Kong stocks and crypto spot.
dashboard.limit: These are independent retrospective windows, not a live account or a continuous equity curve. The current fixed pools have selection bias. USD, HKD and USDT remain separate.

chartNotes.nav: Each window starts at 1. Entry costs are charged before the first scored move; final holdings are not liquidated.
chartNotes.drawdown: Nonnegative drawdown from the running peak, including initial NAV 1.
chartNotes.folds: Each bar is a separate cash-start window, not a compounded account return.
chartNotes.fees: Same strategy and window; only the predeclared one-way fee assumption changes.
chartNotes.scatter: All strategies and windows in the selected market/cost. Higher return and smaller drawdown are preferable, not proof of future performance.
chartNotes.turnover: Daily average includes all scoring periods, not only trading dates.
chartNotes.exposure: Marked model positions; not official competition eligibility.
chartNotes.histogram: Counts of independent window returns for the selected strategy and cost.

insights.title: What the study found
insights.intro: All fixed strategies at the lower predeclared one-way cost for each market. Figures describe separate historical windows, not a compounded account or a forward test.
insights.caveat: Positive excess counts only windows with a benchmark. Zero is not a win. Small, selected pools and retrospective windows limit generalization.
insights.execution: Signals use the previous close and targets are evaluated on daily close-to-close moves. Long-only, cash-funded model; no broker orders or intraday fill simulation. Fees use the selected one-way bps. Current fixed pools are not a point-in-time full-market universe.

descriptions.buy_hold: Start equally allocated across up to ten symbols in sorted identifier order, then let weights drift with prices.
descriptions.benchmark_buy_hold: Hold the declared single-instrument stock benchmark. Its window returns are available; daily curves are withheld.
descriptions.equal_weight: At each daily decision, equally allocate across up to ten symbols in sorted identifier order.
descriptions.crypto_equal_weight: Start equally allocated across the fixed spot pool, then let weights drift with prices. No daily equal-weight rebalance.
descriptions.momentum_20d: Select symbols whose prior-close return over 20 sessions is positive. Take up to ten in sorted identifier order and equally weight them; hold cash if none qualify. This is a sign filter, not a momentum ranking.
descriptions.sma_cross: Select symbols whose 20-session moving average exceeds their 60-session average at the prior close. Take up to ten in sorted identifier order and equally weight them, or hold cash.
descriptions.momentum_63d: Equally weight spot assets whose prior close exceeds their close 63 daily periods earlier. Hold cash if none qualify.
descriptions.trend_200d: Equally weight spot assets whose prior close exceeds their trailing 200-period average. Hold cash if none qualify.
